opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Scheme A: up to £200; Scheme B: up to £500 (up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards); Scheme C: up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members: undergraduate, Master's and PhD students, and postdoctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva. Schemes B & C open to PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva (not undergrad/Master's), with UK base for non-UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences in genetics research, with three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, and (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects, funded by income from the Society's journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member with caring responsibilities, regardless of age of the person they care for.
opportunities.summary: Award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings and events, to be used as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Several levels: a Genetics Society lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session up to about £1,000, major sponsorship of an entire meeting several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorships between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members organising genetic-themed meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, to be used towards the organisation of a meeting.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered both in person and virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities, to support regular series of meetings.
